# PinnacleAI®: The Complete Story | Purpose, Research & Export Readiness
Updated: 2026-09-24

PINNACLEAI® · THE COMPLETE STORY

Built around the child’s life.

A life-first purpose. A documented Indian medical-device foundation. A new chapter in international readiness.

PinnacleAI® brings developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support into the child’s journey—with families and professionals at its heart.

Source-linked editorial review · 24 September 2026

THE PURPOSE

The outcome belongs at the beginning.

A self-sufficient, mainstream and wonderful life for the child determines the abilities, goals, methods, people, practice and review.

That means beginning with the life a child is working toward: communicating, learning, making choices, joining in, building confidence and becoming increasingly independent. A score can inform the next step; the child’s life gives that step its purpose.

Purpose

A self-sufficient, mainstream and wonderful life for the child determines the abilities, goals, people, methods, everyday practice and review.

Measure and plan

The seven-stage pathway connects capability identification and AbilityScore® measurement with readiness forecasting and a child-specific plan.

Support everyday participation

Integrated intervention, parent-guided practice, progress review and reassessment work toward growing independence and participation.

Build accountable technology

PinnacleAI® supports the pathway as licensed non-diagnostic developmental-support software with human and professional review.

THE SEVEN-STAGE PATHWAY

From capability to participation.

The pathway connects professional support with practice at home and review over time. Goals and pace remain individual to each child.

01 Identify capabilities and measure ability

02 Forecast readiness and create a child-specific plan

03 Provide integrated therapies and intervention

04 Support parent-guided everyday practice and home generalisation

05 Track progress and correct the plan

06 Reassess and repeat until readiness

07 Support growing independence, school readiness and mainstream participation

Explore the full life-first philosophy (https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/pinnacle-paradigm-shift.html)

THE SOFTWARE’S ROLE

Support the people supporting the child.

The manufacturing licence names four intended functions. These support measurement, planning and review by the people involved in the child’s development.

Developmental ability measurement

Organise observations of a child’s abilities so the starting point and goals can be discussed.

Readiness tracking

Follow readiness for participation and everyday goals through repeated review.

Progress forecasting

Support planning with forecasts that are considered alongside professional judgement.

Adaptive therapy-plan support

Support review and adjustment of the child-specific plan as information changes.

People remain central. Parents, therapists, educators and caregivers are the intended users. The product is non-diagnostic; clinical and care decisions remain within appropriate human and professional review.

The BIS scope schedule names AbilityScore mapping, Prognose, Everyday Therapy through TherapeuticAI, and tracking and correction through Fusion. These names describe the documented software scope; each child’s goals and outcomes are individual.

MD-5 functions and intended users (https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html) · BIS modules and scope (https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html)

THE INDIAN REGULATORY FOUNDATION

A documented foundation for the next chapter.

Each document answers a different question: what the licensed device does, who manufactures it, which management systems are certified, and what the export certificate establishes.

Class B classification

The operative MD-5 identifies the device as Class B.

The separate issued classification decision is still sought in this collection; the manufacturing licence is the inspected basis for the Class B description.

Inspect the source record (https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/classification.html)

Form MD-5

MFG/MD/2026/000248 · instrument dated 21 April 2026

Names the manufacturer, product, version and non-diagnostic intended use. The FSC cites the base licence date as 20 April; each source is reproduced as printed.

ISO 13485:2016

Medical-device quality-management system

23 SEPTEMBER 2026 · THE EXPORT MILESTONE

Export ready from India.

Free Sale Certificate FSC/MD/2026/000741 adds a documented export foundation to the licensed PinnacleAI product.

Issued by the State Licensing Authority, TG SAFE, Telangana, on 23 September 2026, the certificate references manufacturing licence MFG/MD/2026/000248. It records that the listed device may be manufactured and sold in India under Indian law and exported as per the law of the importing country.

For potential international partners, the practical value is an inspectable source package: product identity, intended use, manufacturer, licence, management-system scope and the export certificate. Market access then proceeds under each destination’s requirements.

Read the public certificate (https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/fsc.pdf) · Read the forwarding letter (https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/fsc-forwarding-letter.pdf)

Indian export documentation is established. A foreign registration or marketing authorisation is a separate, country-specific step.

(https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/fsc.pdf) Read the certificate and original-source notes in the FSC evidence record (https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/fsc.html).

RESEARCH THAT READERS CAN INSPECT

Methods, findings and the next questions.

The research library brings together seven canonical works: six preprints and one report. The records preserve authorship, versions, publication status, original files and reuse licences. Three useful starting points for the PinnacleAI story are:

Preprint · regulatory analysis

The Indian licensing case study

Koti Reddy Saripalli’s documentary analysis of the April 2026 licensing case against later CDSCO guidance. It helps readers follow the regulatory reasoning; it is not an efficacy study.

QUESTIONS FROM FAMILIES AND PARTNERS

Questions, answered with context.

What is PinnacleAI®? PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 is identified in the supplied Indian manufacturing licence as Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support software for children aged 0–12. Its stated functions include developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support.

Who is the legal manufacturer? Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited is the licence holder and legal manufacturer named in the reviewed regulatory records. Pinnacle Blooms Network is the child-development brand and service ecosystem.

What does the Free Sale Certificate establish? FSC/MD/2026/000741 records Indian domestic marketability and export eligibility for the licensed device. It supports country-specific market-access applications; it is not approval or registration in another country.

Does PinnacleAI® diagnose children? No. The licensed product is described as non-diagnostic developmental-support software. Clinical and care decisions remain within the appropriate human and professional review process.

Has PinnacleAI® been registered in other countries? This page does not claim a foreign registration. Each market will be labelled researching, representative appointed, technical file prepared, submitted, under review or registered only when the corresponding evidence is available.

How can the evidence be reused? Use the citation downloads and machine-readable JSON or text exports. Cite the exact licence, certificate or dated report for a specific claim and retain its date and scope.

What does “operating system” mean in the PinnacleAI story? Pinnacle uses GPT-OS in its product name and describes an approach spanning measurement, planning, everyday practice and review. The regulatory description is non-diagnostic developmental-support software; “operating system” is not a separate regulatory approval category.

What does the export milestone mean for my child? The Free Sale Certificate documents the device’s regulatory standing in India and supports international market-access work. For your child, the useful questions remain the individual goals, the care team, everyday practice, progress review and the relevant centre’s records.

Where can a family start? Call Pinnacle’s National Autism Helpline on 9100 181 181 for free guidance, available 24/7. The service is operated by Pinnacle Blooms Network / Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited. Free guidance is separate from assessment or therapy charges; normal call charges may apply.
